# Assets · Marks

1 file under `assets/Marks/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for episode-thumbnail.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Marks

- `episode-thumbnail.svg` — The series mark, copied from EP. 07's loading thumbnail: an isometric tile on a cream square (400 × 400) with a `tile` top, a `tile-shade` left face and a `blue` right face, outlined in 4px `ink`, with a `green` LED and an `amber` cursor bar. Full color, not a single-ink mark, so it cannot be recolored. Use it as a thumbnail or avatar for the series; the series name is always set in type, never as an image.
